title: jmap-metadata-server: reusable stub/default metadata implementation for backends
description: Mark 2026-10-22 (decision on JMAP-s4kp): besides wiring metadata-04 into the 7 MemoryBackends, put a reusable stub in the helper crate jmap-metadata-server so any backend (reference or consumer) gets a working metadata baseline with little code: e.g. a default per-property change tracker for ignoreMetadataOnlyChanges, filter evaluation over WithMetadata<C>, and /set validation (value_depth/exceeds_max_depth, is_namespace_supported) packaged as functions or a small trait with default methods. The 7 MemoryBackend beads (JMAP-s4kp.1-.7) should use it. Refresh s4kp text from -02 to -04 names first.
